requirements.missing: No supplied document provides a university extension or peer-reviewed field-sampling protocol specifically for estimating alfalfa yield (not quality/RFV) prior to harvest with explicitly stated measured inputs and output units in t DM/ha. PEAQ is named in s10, s11, and s13 but estimates RFV (Relative Feed Value), not yield. s2 provides actual harvest yield measurements but is a post-harvest research trial, not a pre-harvest estimation protocol. s14 uses LiDAR/multispectral ML models, not a stated field-sampling protocol.

No supplied document provides a step-by-step sampling procedure with a deterministic conversion from measured field inputs (plant height, stem density, etc.) to estimated yield in t DM/ha. PEAQ procedures in s10/s11/s13 convert height + maturity stage to RFV, not DM yield. s2 documents post-harvest cutting of 0.91×4 m plots to 5 cm stubble and drying at 60 °C to determine DM — this is an actual harvest method, not a pre-harvest prediction method.

None of the supplied documents are scoped to pre-harvest field measurement for yield estimation only. s2 and s14 are post-harvest biomass/yield research. s10, s11, s13 cover pre-harvest RFV estimation, not yield. The scope restriction excludes post-harvest quality data, cumulative DM-rate papers, and growth-index indices — no supplied source meets the pre-harvest yield-estimation-only scope with primary agricultural research or university extension sourcing.
